It is said that a group of {creature:Frost Giant|Frost Giants} tortured a prisoner on the island of {wiki:Tyrsung} and stole his money. Cross the giants' territory to their room and take what is left of the prisoner from a barrel: a {item:Skeleton Decoration}, 89 gp and a {item:Shard}.
They say a group of frost giants tortured a prisoner and stole his money.

No prior quests for the quest itself, but to travel with {npc:Buddel} to {wiki:Tyrsung} you need the {wiki:Barbarian Test Quest} and to have at least started the mission "Nibelor 2: Ecological Terrorism" of {wiki:The Ice Islands Quest}.
Enough potions: the final room has several Frost Giants and Frost Giantesses.
50 gp for each trip with {npc:Buddel} (or a {item:Dwarven Ring} in your backpack so he takes you to the right place).
Sometimes there are stray creatures lured by other players: {creature:Smuggler}, {creature:Pirate Marauder}, {creature:Bandit} or {creature:Hunter}.

In **Svargrond**, go to the boat **south** of the city and talk to {npc:Buddel}: {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:tyrsung} and confirm with {key:yes}. The trip costs 50 gp. You disembark at the dock of {wiki:Tyrsung} ({coord:32332,31230,7}).

Buddel is always drunk and may take you to the wrong place. If you carry a {item:Dwarven Ring} in your backpack, he takes you to the right destination (he keeps the ring and does not charge the 50 gp). To avoid losing the ring, say {key:no} when he asks for it or use it in the ring slot.
Go around the mountain by the **east** until you find a staircase going up. Climb it.
Map with the path to the barrel
Follow the slope to the cave

On this floor there are many {creature:Frost Giant|Frost Giants}, {creature:Frost Giantess|Frost Giantesses} and {creature:Mammoth|Mammoths}. Start walking **west** and follow the cliff until you reach a cave.
Do not pull several giants and mammoths at the same time.
Inside the cave, go down the stairs.
In the new cave head **north** and then **east**, until you find stairs going down. Go down.
Head **north** until you reach a room with quite a few {creature:Frost Giant|Frost Giants} and {creature:Frost Giantess|Frost Giantesses}. Clear the room or lure them in small groups.
The room has lots of giants: do not get surrounded and keep your potions at hand.
In the **north** part of the room there is a barrel on a table. Open it to receive the reward.

Go back the same way: climb the stairs of the two caves, leave the cave by the slope, go around the cliff back to the **east**, go down the staircase and go around the mountain to the dock. Talk to {npc:Buddel} in Tyrsung: {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:svargrond}, {key:yes} to return to the dock south of Svargrond.
